# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: left/right margins (DECLRMM ?69, DECSLRM), DECIC/DECDC/DECBI/DECFI, reverse wrap (?45, ?1045)   (issue #97, wave 9)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/margins_spec.txt   (spec-researcher output, 2026-11-01; converted by the implementer)
#
# FORMAT (read by tests/margins.rs)
#   Grid rows use the csi_spec.txt layout (### ID / size / step / screen / cursor / pending_wrap / requests / scrollback),
#   checked with tests/spec/mod.rs check_case, whole and byte by byte. `\x1b` is ESC, `\x08` BS, `\u{H}` a scalar.
#   Reply rows (section 7: RP, RM and RS ids) use the reports_spec.txt layout: `\e` is ESC and `reply:` the exact
#   Request::Reply bytes of the whole row, concatenated; `step: resize RxC` calls Terminal::resize. A reply row may also
#   carry `screen:`/`cursor:`/`pending_wrap:` (RS18).
#   `cite:`, `note:`, `flags:` and `correction:` are documentation. `correction:` marks a row the implementer changed
#   from the researcher's model after re-reading the cited xterm function (the original value is quoted).
#
# HOW THE ROWS WERE PRODUCED
#   Sections 1-6: the researcher's Python model of xterm (charproc.c, cursor.c, util.c, tabs.c, screen.c, misc.c of
#   ThomasDickey/xterm-snapshots master, read 2026-11-01), byte streams run through it; about twenty hand-checked
#   against esctest2. Sections 7-9: hand-written from misc.c and reports_spec.txt. Nothing was run on a real xterm.
#
# DECISIONS (milestone lead, 2026-11-01: the researcher's recommendations D1-D9 accepted)
#   D1  DECLRMM, DECSLRM, DECIC, DECDC, DECBI, DECFI, DECRQSS `s` and DECRQM ?69 need conformance level >= 4 (xterm
#       vtXX_level >= 4); DA1 lists 21 only there (`CSI ? 64 ; 21 ; 22 c`).
#   D2  ?1045 (extended reverse wraparound) is in scope.
#   D3  a wrap at the right margin marks the row soft-wrapped (xterm WrapLine sets LINEWRAPPED), also when the margin
#       is not the screen edge.
#   D4  a resize resets the margins to the full screen; DECLRMM stays set.
#   D5  reverse wrap never enters the scrollback: at screen row 0 it stops (xterm would read the newest history line).
#   D6  HT right of the right margin follows xterm (TabToNextStop clamps to the margin, so the cursor moves back; CM13).
#   D7  one margin set, shared by the primary and the alternate screen (RS17).
#   D8  a wide character that does not fit before the right margin wraps early, leaving the margin cell blank (WD01).
#   D9  SL/SR (CSI Ps SP @ / SP A) are out of scope.
#
# Default state before every row: DECAWM on, IRM off, LNM off, no margins, tab stops every 8, pen default, level 4.
# Base screen `P` (4x10): `abcdefgh / ijklmnop / qrstuvwx / yzABCDEF`. `S` = `\x1b[?69h\x1b[3;6s` (margins 3-6).
# =============================================================================

# ============================================================================================================
# 1. MODE AND DECSLRM (model-generated)
# ============================================================================================================

### LR01_off_decslrm_with_params_is_ignored
size: 3x10
step: feed \x1b[3;6sabcdefghij
cite: [CTL] "CSI s (SCOSC) ... available only when DECLRMM is disabled"; [XT charproc.c CASE_ANSI_SC] with DECLRMM off, params present: neither save nor margins
note: Negative control for LR02: without ?69 the sequence changes nothing; row 0 fills to the screen edge and the wrap is pending.
screen:
>abcdefghij|
>
>
cursor: (0,9)
pending_wrap: true
requests: []
scrollback: len=0

### LR02_on_decslrm_text_wraps_inside_margins
size: 3x10
step: feed \x1b[?69h\x1b[3;6sabcdefgh
cite: [E decset.py test_DECSET_DECLRMM] margins 2;4 write abcdefgh -> abcd / .efg / .h ; [XT charproc.c WrapLine: IND + cursor to left margin]
note: DECSLRM homes the cursor to column 1 (outside the margins, as in xterm CursorSet(0,0)), so a and b print left of the left margin. f is in the right-margin column (pending wrap); g wraps to the LEFT margin of the next row. Row 0 is marked soft-wrapped (xterm LineSetFlag LINEWRAPPED in WrapLine).
flags: decision D3 (wrapped flag on a margin wrap)
screen:
>abcdef\
>  gh |
>
cursor: (1,4)
pending_wrap: false
requests: []
scrollback: len=0

# ============================================================================================================
# 10. ESCTEST LIFT TABLE: the 31 `#> #97` blocks of esctest_spec.txt (53 test ids) -> source, and the row here that pins the same rule
# ============================================================================================================
# esctest_pending.txt has no blocks and the `#>` lines carry bytes only for some ids: transcribe the rest from
# https://github.com/ThomasDickey/esctest2/tree/master/esctest/tests/<file>.py through the helpers in esccmd.py (Point(x,y) -> CUP y;x,
# DECSLRM(l,r) -> CSI l;r s, DECSET(DECLRMM) -> CSI ? 69 h; esctest.py reset() before each test: 25x80, DECAWM on, tabs every 8), exactly as the
# wave-5 rows were produced. The 25x80 rows keep esctest's own geometry; the 4x10 rows above are the same rules at hand-checkable size.
#
# id (esctest2 file / test)                                                                     | rule                                                   | covering row(s)
# E_CUP_respectsOriginMode (cup.py)                                                              | origin mode relative to margins, clamped               | CM15, LR04
# E_HPA_/E_VPA_/E_HVP_/E_HPR_/E_VPR_ ignores/respectsOriginMode (hpa vpa hvp hpr vpr)           | same                                                   | CM15 (+ model: cursor_set_col/row)
# E_CHA_ignoresScrollRegion, E_CHA_respectsOriginMode (cha.py)                                   | CHA ignores margins; origin relative                   | CM14, CM15
# E_CUF_stopsAtRightMarginInScrollRegion, ...RightEdgeWhenBegunRightOfScrollRegion (cuf.py)     | CUF stop at R / edge                                   | CM01, CM03 (CM02 extra)
# E_CUB_stopsAtLeftMarginInScrollRegion, ...LeftEdgeWhenBegunLeftOfScrollRegion (cub.py)        | CUB stop at L / col 1                                  | CM04, CM05 (CM06 extra)
# E_CUB_afterNoWrappedInlines, E_CUB_afterOneWrappedInline (cub.py; ?45, xterm >= 383)          | ?45 only into soft-wrapped rows                        | RW02, RW03, RW14
# E_CNL_stopsAtBottom*/E_CPL_stopsAtTop* (cnl.py, cpl.py)                                        | CNL/CPL end at L (CR) and stop at the bot/top margin   | CM07 (CR rule) + SC04 (clamp)
# E_CBT_ignoresRegion, E_CHT_ignoresScrollingRegion (cbt.py, cht.py)                             | CBT ignores margins; CHT stops at R                    | CM12, CM13
# E_ED_0/1/2_withScrollRegion (ed.py), E_EL_ignoresScrollRegion (el.py), E_ECH_* (ech.py)        | erases ignore the margins                              | ED17-ED22
# E_ICH_isNoOpWhenCursorBeginsOutsideScrollRegion, E_ICH_scrollOffRightMarginInScrollRegion      | ICH within L..R only                                   | ED10-ED13
# E_DCH_respectsMargins, E_DCH_deleteAllWithMargins, E_DCH_doesNothingOutsideLeftRightMargin     | DCH within L..R only                                   | ED14-ED16
# E_IL_respectsScrollRegion(_over), E_DL_outsideLeftRightAndTopBottomScrollRegion (il.py, dl.py)| IL/DL rectangle + no-op outside                         | ED01-ED09
# E_SU_*/E_SD_* (8 ids: respects / outside / leftRightAndTopBottom / bigScroll; su.py, sd.py)    | SU/SD rectangle (cursor unchanged)                     | SC09-SC11, SC07, SC08
# E_REP_respectsLeftRightMargins (rep.py)                                                        | REP wraps inside the margins                           | LR02 (REP = N prints, same wrap path)
# E_DECALN_clearsMargins (decaln.py)                                                             | DECALN resets margins                                  | RS14
# E_IND_/E_RI_/E_NEL_movesDoesNotScrollOutsideLeftRight (ind.py ri.py nel.py)                    | no scroll when the cursor is outside L..R              | SC04-SC06 (+ SC01-SC03 inside)
# E_DECRC_/E_SCORC_saveRestoreCursor_resetsOriginMode, _worksInLRM (decrc.py, scorc.py)          | CSI 5;7 s is DECSLRM when ?69 on, SCOSC otherwise      | SCR01-SCR03, LR06
# E_DECRC_/E_SCORC_saveRestoreCursor_reverseWrapNotAffected                                      | save/restore keeps the pending wrap, ?45 state not saved| RW05 + SCR01 (DECSC saves the wrap flag today)
# NOT in the `#>` list but in esctest2 and now testable: bs.py (BS_* with ?45/?1045/margins) -> RW01-RW16; decset.py
#   DECSET_DECLRMM*, _MarginsResetByDECSTR, _ModeResetByDECSTR, _DECCOLM -> LR02, LR07-LR09, RS09, RS13; decic/decdc/decbi/decfi.py -> CO01-CO20.

# ============================================================================================================
# 11. VTTEST (vttest 2.7 vt420.c, main menu 11 -> 3 "Test of VT420 features")
# ============================================================================================================
# 11.3.2 "Test cursor-movement": toggles `?69` (toggle_LRMM), DECSTBM (tb_marg 1..2 flavours: reset / top half / bottom half / middle half),
#   DECSLRM (same four flavours), DECOM; then
#   - "Test Back Index (DECBI)" / "Test Forward Index (DECFI)": numbers 1..N written and shifted with ESC 6 / ESC 9 four at a time -> CO12-CO20.
#   - "Test cursor movement within margins": CUF/CUB 99-style walks to the margin from the margin; CUU/CUD to the border -> CM01-CM06.
#   - "Test other movement (CR/HT/LF/FF) within margins": BS x N to col 1 from L, HT x N from R, IND x N down the margin, FF, NEL+CUF, RI -> CM07-CM13, SC01-SC06.
#   Reset between sub-tests uses `ESC [ s` (decslrm(0,0)) while ?69 is set and `CSI r` for DECSTBM: LR06 pins that.
# 11.3.3 "Test editing sequences": "Test insert/delete column (DECIC, DECDC)" with margins/origin -> CO01-CO11.
# 11.3.x also has "Show DECRQM response for DECLRMM" / "Show DECRQSS response for DECSLRM" (menu items) -> RM01-RM03, RS01-RS05.
# The rectangle tests (DECCRA/DECERA/DECFRA/DECSERA/DECCARA/DECRARA) also use test_with_margins() but are other issues.
# vttest.rs in this crate replays captured menus; there is no margin capture, and none is needed: every sequence above is a row.

# ============================================================================================================
# 12. ORIGIN MODE KEEPS THE OTHER COORDINATE; ROWS ADDED IN CRITIC ROUND 1 (hand-written from the cited xterm source)
# ============================================================================================================
# xterm's CASE_HPA/CHA, VPA, HPR and VPR call CursorSet with CursorRow(xw) / CursorCol(xw), which are cur_row - top_marg
# and cur_col - lft_marg in origin mode and may be NEGATIVE (a cursor above or left of the margins; the asserts are off
# in release builds); CursorSet adds the margin back, so the kept coordinate stays where it is, clamped only to the
# bottom/right margin. `\x1b[?6h\x1b7` saves the home cursor WITH origin mode; DECRC after a DECSTBM/DECSLRM brings
# it back above/left of the new margins in origin mode.

### OR01_cha_in_origin_mode_keeps_a_row_above_the_region

note: DECRC restores row 0 (above the region 3-6) with origin mode on; CHA 5 keeps row 0. Same as before #97 (the default path).
